'''IG-113''' was an [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuard]] serving the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] on board a [[Crashed Munificent-class star frigate|Munificent-class star frigate]], who was bigger than other MagnaGuards. At about [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] shot down the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]], although IG-113 survived the crash. The Republic sent down [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]] to finish off the remaining [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], but they encountered [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] [[Skirmish on Carlac|resistance]]. [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|A Jedi Knight]] investigated the wreck and found IG-113, destroying [[Gender/Legends|him]].

==Behind the scenes==
IG-113 first appeared in "[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)]]" at the Skirmish on Carlac combat zone. After defeating IG-113 many times, the player is given IG-113's electrostaff. He very rarely appeared, as players would have to wait for half an hour for him spawn.
